name: AKASH SVG
svg_template:
<svg width="481" height="420" viewBox="0 0 481 420" fill="none" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
  <defs>

    
    <linearGradient id="main-gradient" x1="160" y1="420" x2="400" y2="0" gradientUnits="userSpaceOnUse">

      
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="${color-main}" stop-opacity="1"/>

      
      <stop offset="45%" stop-color="${color-main}" stop-opacity="1">
        <animate
          attributeName="stop-color"
          values="${color-main};${color-accent};${color-main}"
          dur="${pulse-a}s"
          keyTimes="0;0.5;1"
          keySplines="0.45 0 0.55 1; 0.45 0 0.55 1"
          calcMode="spline"
          repeatCount="indefinite"/>
      </stop>

      
      <stop offset="78%" stop-color="${color-accent}" stop-opacity="0">
        <animate
          attributeName="stop-opacity"
          values="${alpha-lo};${alpha-hi};${alpha-lo}"
          dur="${pulse-a}s"
          keyTimes="0;0.5;1"
          keySplines="0.45 0 0.55 1; 0.45 0 0.55 1"
          calcMode="spline"
          repeatCount="indefinite"/>
        <animate
          attributeName="stop-color"
          values="${color-accent};${color-main};${color-accent}"
          dur="${pulse-b}s"
          keyTimes="0;0.5;1"
          keySplines="0.45 0 0.55 1; 0.45 0 0.55 1"
          calcMode="spline"
          repeatCount="indefinite"/>
      </stop>

      
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="${color-accent}" stop-opacity="${alpha-lo}">
        <animate
          attributeName="stop-opacity"
          values="${alpha-lo};${alpha-hi};${alpha-lo}"
          dur="${pulse-b}s"
          keyTimes="0;0.5;1"
          keySplines="0.45 0 0.55 1; 0.45 0 0.55 1"
          calcMode="spline"
          repeatCount="indefinite"/>
      </stop>

    </linearGradient>

    
    <linearGradient id="solid-gradient" x1="480" y1="0" x2="0" y2="420" gradientUnits="userSpaceOnUse">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="${color-main}"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="${color-main}">
        <animate
          attributeName="stop-color"
          values="${color-main};${color-accent};${color-main}"
          dur="${pulse-b}s"
          keyTimes="0;0.5;1"
          keySplines="0.45 0 0.55 1; 0.45 0 0.55 1"
          calcMode="spline"
          repeatCount="indefinite"/>
        <animate
          attributeName="stop-opacity"
          values="0;${alpha-mid};0"
          dur="${pulse-b}s"
          keyTimes="0;0.5;1"
          keySplines="0.45 0 0.55 1; 0.45 0 0.55 1"
          calcMode="spline"
          repeatCount="indefinite"/>
      </stop>
    </linearGradient>

  </defs>

  
  <path
    d="M321.355 279.4L400.615 419.038H240.511L160.415 279.4H321.355Z"
    fill="url(#main-gradient)"/>

  
  <path
    d="M400.572 419.061L480.536 279.423L320.476 0.0800781H160.415L400.572 419.061Z"
    fill="${color-main}"/>
  
  <path
    d="M400.572 419.061L480.536 279.423L320.476 0.0800781H160.415L400.572 419.061Z"
    fill="url(#solid-gradient)"
    opacity="${alpha-bleed}"/>

  <path
    d="M80.3874 139.682H240.449L80.454 419.025L0.357422 279.387L80.3874 139.682Z"
    fill="${color-main}"/>
  
  <path
    d="M80.3874 139.682H240.449L80.454 419.025L0.357422 279.387L80.3874 139.682Z"
    fill="url(#solid-gradient)"
    opacity="${alpha-bleed}"/>

</svg>
